content.short: TON Guard is a security-focused initiative designed to protect TON users and projects from vulnerabilities.
content.description: TON Guard is a dedicated security initiative within The Open Network (TON) ecosystem, focused on enhancing the overall safety and resilience of the network. It provides a range of tools and resources designed to help developers identify vulnerabilities in their smart contracts and protect users from common scams and malicious activity. TON Guard emphasizes community-driven security, fostering a culture of transparency and proactive protection to ensure that the TON blockchain remains a secure environment for innovation and digital asset management.
content.meta: Stay safe on TON with TON Guard's security tools and resources. Explore Web3 safety on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
